steps.skipped: The Calendar module keeps no plan fingerprint (no PlanState/PlanChanged). The plan returns the ETag of the event and the confirmed call carries it: when the event changed in between, the ETag no longer matches and the call is refused as a conflict (If-Match), without a new plan.

steps.skipped: Calendar objects are not Files nodes: no system tag or excluded folder can hide a calendar or an event from MCP (VisibilityGuard and FilesAccessGuard do not apply). What narrows the reachable calendars is the administrator resource scope and the native ACL, which are scope and permission refusals, not visibility.
